schemaRulesToPreserve: The envelope and every nested object remain additionalProperties=false.
subject.ads_profile is exactly ads/github/v5:report and feedback source_status is PINNED with an exact 40-hex source_sha.
revision 1 has supersedes=null; every later revision has an exact object supersedes reference.
INDEPENDENTLY_CHECKED requires epistemic=OBSERVED and at least one unique verifier reference; every other phase has verifier_refs=[].
publication.classification is exactly PUBLISHABLE and projection_digest is an exact SHA-256 digest.
Schema shape validation never substitutes for native repository, identity, permission, currentness or readback verification.

admissionGate.blockDisposition: If any required proof is absent, publish ADMISSION_BLOCK with the exact missing evidence and stop before all six source paths and all real feedback publication.

responsibilities: Accept only bounded Tally-owned source-qualified DTOs for experience identity, Procedure revision, Task/Attempt/Review, exact source SHA, human decision, actual use and optional independently verified outcome.
Project exactly the pinned ADS feedback envelope; reuse validateAdsV5Report and compute deterministic canonical digests without inventing Tally-specific public fields.
Bind producer build SHA separately from Task/Attempt source SHA and preserve exact report identity/revision/supersedes semantics.
Return typed refusals with authorized=false, taskPass=false and releasePass=false; perform no I/O, GitHub write, activation or outcome inference.
Positive presented/applied/rejected/independently checked fixtures with exact schema-blob validation and deterministic replay.
Every source, decision, schema, privacy, UNKNOWN, revision and supersession negative in sourceEvidenceFailClosedMatrix.
Expose only a Host-bound selected-C port with trusted writer authority and authenticated Octokit; no browser, Agent or request-supplied grant.

Serialize the already validated ADS envelope, publish to the exact repository/Issue subject, re-read the exact native comment and independently validate repository, report identity, source SHA, schema/profile, digest, writer, currentness and complete pagination.
Reconcile lost or invalid ACK before any retry; exact duplicate replay returns the existing verified native object, same-identity divergence refuses, and no unbounded second post or new queue exists.
Support revisioned supersession and existing ADS correction reconciliation without treating transport ACK, schema validity or HTTP 2xx as publication PASS.
Positive exact native readback and idempotent replay; lost ACK found/missing/ambiguous branches.
403/429/5xx, wrong repository/writer, stale source, partial pagination, duplicate identity, correction conflict and supersession negatives with bounded/no-post assertions.
Validate bounded UI requests and connect only to the existing selected Host feedback-publication port; UI never constructs ADS wire YAML and never supplies writer authority.
Re-read selected Host/source state before dispatch and return exact published/refused/unknown reconciliation state with measuredBenefit=UNKNOWN where no independent outcome exists.
Do not mount runtime routes, edit #262, call task-meta, activate artifacts or infer adoption/quality uplift.
Scope/staleness/request allowlist and receipt validation, disconnected/UNKNOWN degradation and no-forged-authority tests.
Prove no automatic Rule/Skill/Procedure/Workflow/Domain-Package activation and no private fields in the Host request.

phaseMapping.meaning: A reviewed experience was presented; this alone is not acceptance, application or effect.
A current qualified human adoption decision exists; this alone is not actual application.
Selected-Host evidence proves explicit use in the bound Task/Attempt; this alone is not a successful outcome.
A current qualified human reject/non-use decision exists with its review/source references; it is not a failure metric.
A later independent verifier checked the exact experience/source identity; verifier_refs is nonempty and epistemic=OBSERVED.
Only a bounded observed effect supported by source_refs is represented; missing or self-reported effect remains UNKNOWN and is never promoted to measured uplift.

identityAndReplay: Stable report identity binds repository, publisher namespace, experience_ref, procedure_revision, Task/Attempt, phase and revision; deterministic serialization and projection_digest make byte-equivalent replay detectable.
A correction of the same logical report uses the same report_id, increments revision by one and carries the exact immediately preceding revision, data_digest and comment_ref in supersedes.
A distinct later phase does not erase an earlier still-true phase; conflicting duplicate identity/digest/source/currentness is CONFLICT, never last-write-wins.
privacyAllowlist: Public repository/Issue/PR/comment/commit/check/review references and bounded public identities only.
No secrets, tokens, cookies, private task-meta fields, private prompts, hidden tests, raw traces, Chain-of-Thought, unrestricted free text or private Manifest content.
Any unknown DTO key or non-allowlisted nested value fails closed before serialization or logging.

sourceEvidenceFailClosedMatrix.reason: Wrong envelope, report kind, ADS profile, schema blob or any additional/missing required key.
No Tally-owned human-reviewed evidence and exact experience/Procedure identity.
Decision is absent, expired, superseded, stale-revision or lacks qualified reviewer/source evidence.
Never map presentation/adoption alone to APPLIED, OBSERVED_EFFECT or uplift.
Application remains distinct from success; no zero, PASS, quality gain or cost is invented.
INDEPENDENTLY_CHECKED requires exact independent verifier_refs and OBSERVED evidence; self-report cannot be upgraded.
Exact source-qualified Task/Attempt/Review and 40-hex identity are mandatory.
Current source differs, moves during publication, or two observations conflict.
Repository, Issue, report subject, publisher repository or writer does not exactly match trusted Host scope.
Privacy allowlist rejects the complete payload before transport; error output does not echo sensitive input.
No accepted exact Claim/CAS/FSW, Host resource fence, selected-K permit or effective GitHub permission.
Do not report PASS or retry through another identity/publisher.
Provider failure is not failure of the reported experience and not publication success; reconcile before bounded replay.
Complete native readback proves exactly one matching repository/identity/digest/source/writer/current object.
Only after complete current readback proves absence; any ambiguity stops without a new post.
Never guess which native object is authoritative.
Return the already verified object without an additional publication.
Same report identity/revision with different digest/source/repository/writer is a conflict.
Nonlinear revision, wrong supersedes target/digest/comment or conflicting correction is refused and reconciled.
ACK/schema validity cannot replace exact native object, currentness and complete readback.
No private ingress, no fabricated zero/PASS and no new dependency for ordinary Task/Release.
No automatic Rule/Skill/Procedure/Workflow/Domain-Package activation and no Task/Review/Release PASS from feedback.

realNativeAcceptanceAfterSeparateAuthori: Use a dedicated authorized GitHub test subject and selected Host/C writer only after admission and publication scope are explicit.
Publish one exact ADS v5 feedback object and independently re-read repository, identity, source SHA, schema/profile, currentness and complete native readback.
Exercise lost ACK and deterministic idempotent replay without unbounded comments; verify correction/supersession and duplicate refusal.
Permit task-meta v0.4 only as an independent public-GitHub observer; Tally never calls private task-meta API/storage.
Keep actual publication evidence separate from unit fixtures and never turn feedback into Task/Review/Release PASS.
finalExactSha: Post HEAD/TREE/BASE/PackBlob/Claim/FSW, native feedback ref/readback and every test exit on Issue #274 and the source PR.
Run existing Woodpecker once for the final source SHA; do not duplicate an already passing run.
Obtain independent final Exact-SHA review; any reviewer repair requires a new independent SHA witness.
No main/tag/Release/deploy or E/#264 mount is authorized by this Pack.
